display.purpose: Page titles such as 项目 and 提交历史; one per view.

headline.purpose: Empty-state and AI greeting headings; compresses at short window heights.

title.purpose: Project names, sheet titles, and merge-request detail titles.

body.purpose: Working interface copy; long explanatory text runs 12.5px/1.75.

label.purpose: Section labels and table headers; uppercase only for Latin.

code.purpose: Hashes, paths, branch routes, model addresses, and code only.

shadows.name: floating-menu
shadows.purpose: Project overflow menu and small popovers.

shadows.name: local-lift
shadows.purpose: A single-pixel lift for small raised controls.

motion.name: ease-view
motion.purpose: View enter on route change; 0.22s in, 0.28s settle.

motion.name: ease-sheet
motion.purpose: Sheet slide-in at 0.3s and delta channel drawing at 0.95s.

motion.name: hover
motion.purpose: Buttons, rows, fields, and chips at rest-to-hover.

motion.name: delta-draw
motion.purpose: One-time delta channel draw with staggered delays when a project opens.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Collapses animation to 0.01ms while preserving loading and caret visibility.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single teal action in a region, e.g. 添加项目 or 新建合并请求.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A bordered secondary action that sits on paper, e.g. 刷新.

components.name: Quiet Destructive Button
components.description: Removal and close actions that should be visible but not shout.

components.name: Search Pill

components.name: App Navigation
components.description: The centered pill navigation inside the 64px ink app bar.

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: Small labels for refs, topics, and states; the active variant carries teal meaning.

components.name: Field Input
components.description: The standard stacked label + value field used in sheets and settings.
components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;min-width:0;font-family:var(--font-ui)}.ds-field span{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.03em}.ds-field input{width:100%;min-width:0;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:9px;outline:none;background:rgba(251,247,238,.72);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font-ui);font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.5;transition:border-color .16s ease,background-color .16s ease,box-shadow .16s ease}.ds-field input:hover{border-color:rgba(32,36,31,.38)}.ds-field input:focus{border-color:rgba(31,110,106,.55);background:var(--sheet);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(31,110,106,.11)}

components.name: AI Quick Action
components.description: The 2×2 empty-state actions in the AI view; a contained card with a teal icon tile.

components.name: Project Row
components.description: The atlas index row: generated delta plate, display name, mono path, branch meta, circular open control.
components.css: .ds-project{display:grid;grid-template-columns:84px minmax(0,1fr) 36px;align-items:center;gap:20px;width:100%;min-height:88px;padding:15px 62px 15px 4px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font-ui);text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .16s ease}.ds-project:hover{background:rgba(251,247,238,.55)}.ds-project:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--teal);outline-offset:-3px}.ds-project-art{display:grid;place-items:center;width:84px;height:52px;padding:5px 8px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;background:rgba(251,247,238,.55);transition:border-color .18s ease,background-color .18s ease}.ds-project:hover .ds-project-art{border-color:rgba(31,110,106,.32);background:var(--sheet)}.ds-project-art svg{width:100%;height:100%}.ds-project-info{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0}.ds-project-name{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:19px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:-.015em;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.ds-project-path{margin-top:3px;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.ds-project-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-top:6px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:11px}.ds-project-meta svg{color:var(--teal)}.ds-project-open{display:grid;place-items:center;width:34px;height:34px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:50%;color:var(--ink-soft);transition:background-color .18s ease,border-color .18s ease,color .18s ease,transform .18s ease}.ds-project:hover .ds-project-open{border-color:var(--teal);background:var(--teal);color:#fffcf4;transform:translate(1px,-1px)}

components.name: Commit Row
components.description: A 42px river-line history row; selection is a teal wash with a filled graph node.

narrative.overview:
A repository is a watershed and its history is a river network; branches split and merge like tributaries. Easy Git is the atlas you work in: warm survey paper, an ink sky at the top, hairline survey rules, and generated delta line art that draws itself when a repository opens. The project index reads like an atlas index; a project opens into a working map of its own history. Nothing here is meant to feel like a dashboard, a control panel, or a backoffice.

Density is treated as legibility rather than authority. Most surfaces sit unframed on paper and are separated by 1px rules; contained cards exist only for self-contained groups such as a merge-request report or a settings block. The one ink field is the 64px app bar; everything below it stays paper, sheet, or paper-deep. Actions speak in teal, attention and destruction in coral, warnings and tags in ochre, success in moss, and AI in plum — each color carries a meaning, none is decoration.

The type pairing does the quiet work: Bricolage Grotesque gives Latin display, project names, and numerals a measured, cartographic character; Public Sans and Microsoft YaHei keep the Chinese interface plain and fast to read; mono is confined to hashes, paths, routes, and code. Motion is short and purposeful — a view settles in 0.22s, a sheet slides in 0.3s, the delta plate draws in under a second — and all of it yields to `prefers-reduced-motion`.
keyCharacteristics: Warm survey paper field under a single ink app bar.
Structure from hairline rules and paper tones, not panels or resting shadows.
One teal action voice; semantic accents stay rare and meaningful.
Generated delta line art as the identity, echoed by the commit graph.
Tabular numerals and an 11px functional type floor.
One 1180px column for index surfaces; work area plus a fixed inspector rail inside a project.
Chinese-first copy with a Chinese-aware font stack, never Latin tracking on CJK.

rules.name: The Ink Sky Rule
rules.body: Atlas Ink fills the 64px app bar and nothing else of scale. Every other large surface stays paper, sheet, or paper-deep; if a screen feels unanchored, add a rule or a heading, not a dark panel.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Teal is for the one primary action in a region. Coral, ochre, moss, and plum are semantic and may be absent from a screen entirely. None of them is decorative.

rules.name: The 11px Floor Rule
rules.body: No functional label, table header, badge, or metadata drops below 11px; prose stays at 12px or larger. Reduce content before shrinking type.

rules.name: The Chinese Pair Rule
rules.body: Bricolage Grotesque carries Latin display, project names, and numerals only. Chinese always falls through to Microsoft YaHei or PingFang in the same stack and never receives Latin uppercase tracking.

rules.name: The One Column Rule
rules.body: Index and settings surfaces use a single 1180px column. Project workspaces split into work area plus one fixed inspector or list rail. No persistent sidebar and no widget grid.

rules.name: The Floating-Only Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong to overlays. Resting cards, rows, and panels are separated by hairlines and paper tones; if content needs emphasis, change its type or add a rule, not a shadow.

rules.name: The Quiet Corner Rule
rules.body: Use 6–10px for controls and plates, 12–14px for surfaces, and 999px for pills and circles. Never exceed 14px except for a pill.

dos: Do keep Survey Paper as the page field and reserve Atlas Ink for the 64px app bar.
Do build hierarchy with 1px hairlines and the paper → sheet → paper-fold tonal stack.
Do keep functional type at 11px or larger and prose at 12px or larger; use tabular numerals for hashes, dates, counts, and diffs.
Do give each region one teal primary action and leave destructive actions in coral.
Do set Chinese in the UI stack (Public Sans → YaHei/PingFang) and reserve Bricolage for Latin display and numerals.
Do animate the delta draw and sheet transitions at 0.16–0.3s and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do let lists scroll inside their own region while the app bar and rails stay fixed.
donts: Don't introduce a sidebar, gray admin panels, a KPI card grid, or dashboard chrome anywhere in the app.
Don't use coral, ochre, moss, plum, or slate as decoration; they are meaning-bound.
Don't put shadows on resting content or round any working surface beyond 14px.
Don't set Chinese in Bricolage or mono, or apply uppercase Latin tracking to CJK.
Don't shrink functional labels below 11px or body copy below 12px to win density; cut content instead.
Don't use pure white page backgrounds; Fresh Sheet and Button Ivory are the lightest acceptable surfaces.
Don't add a second dark surface or a second accent voice to a screen that already has one.
